//: EAS build profiles. All three produce an APK, never an AAB: Switchboard self-distributes through GitHub Releases and updates itself in-app (src/lib/selfUpdate.ts), so there is no Play Store upload that would need an AAB. Requires an EAS account plus repo secret EXPO_TOKEN for CI.

development.//: THIS is the profile needed to test Google sign-in. Sign-in cannot work in Expo Go at all: it needs an Android-type OAuth client bound to the package (app.switchboard.mobile) AND the build's signing SHA-1, and Expo Go's redirect is exp://, which Google rejects for custom-scheme flows. Install this build on the device, then register its SHA-1 (`eas credentials`) on the Android OAuth client. Everything except sign-in still runs in Expo Go.

preview.//: Release-mode build for testing the real thing off-CI. Same artifact shape as production, so it also exercises the self-update code path.

production.//: What .github/workflows/mobile-release.yml builds and attaches to the GitHub Release. autoIncrement is off on purpose: expo.version in app.json is the single source of truth, hand-bumped in the commit, and both the release tag and the OTA runtimeVersion are derived from it. Auto-incrementing would desync the tag from the binary.

submit.//: No submit profiles. Nothing is submitted to a store; releases go out as GitHub Release assets.
